decisions.reason: Multiline entry and manual line-break support are independent of whether placeholder text clears on field activation; the candidate already has its own same-message introduction.

Clearing placeholder text when a field is activated does not remove or alter the persistent label and help-text rules; the behaviors can coexist and label coverage already applies to all interactive fields.
The source scope change governs placeholder-clearing behavior, not the underlying editable-field mechanism or handling of password-dependent legacy controls.
Fixed margins and prevention of pencil-icon clipping are separately stated layout requirements and are not changed by extending placeholder-clearing behavior.
The approved color-availability policy is an independent Master-template decision and remains unchanged by the placeholder-clearing scope extension.
Bullet sizing and spacing are independent visual-style requirements and are unaffected by interactive-field placeholder behavior.
Hard-return spacing and Shift+Enter behavior are separately specified text-entry semantics; extending placeholder clearing does not modify them.
Preventing an unintended border when extending a Board Meeting row is independent of clearing placeholder text on activation.
The source decision does not address legacy-to-new copy-paste behavior or resolve the candidate's existing workflow ambiguity.
Required style-system coverage and missing style entries remain valid unchanged; placeholder activation behavior does not alter the style set.
Typography attributes for headings, titles, and caption text are unrelated to the placeholder-clearing scope change.
Table and column stability during pasted-content workflows is independent of placeholder clearing, and the source decision does not resolve the existing table-adjustment ambiguity.
